name: Memorigi
description_en:
Memorigi is a personal task and planning application that organizes work into groups, lists, headings, tasks and subtasks. Its useful distinction is between a Do Date—the day intended for doing the work—and a Deadline—the commitment by which it must be completed. Today, Upcoming, Logbook and board-style organization provide different ways to review that work.

The official site links Android and Galaxy clients and a separate Web sign-in. Cloud, Google Calendar viewing and other advanced features have subscription conditions. This documentation-based profile focuses on planning semantics, repetition, device/account access and payment/data conditions; it does not claim a tested reminder, sync session or productivity improvement.
description_zh:
Memorigi 是个人任务及规划应用，按组、列表、标题分区、任务和子任务组织工作。一个有用区别是 Do Date 表示打算执行的日期，Deadline 表示必须完成的承诺日期。Today、Upcoming、Logbook 及看板式组织提供不同复核方式。

官网链接 Android、Galaxy 客户端及独立 Web 登录。云同步、Google Calendar 查看和其他进阶功能有订阅条件。以下基于文档聚焦规划含义、重复、设备／账户访问及付款／数据条件，没有声称实测提醒、同步会话或生产力提升。

sections.title_en: Rescheduling the work is not renegotiating its deadline
sections.title_zh: 调整执行日期不等于重议截止承诺
sections.en:
For a hypothetical course assignment due Friday, choose Tuesday as the intended writing day and retain Friday as the deadline. If work moves to Wednesday, inspect both fields instead of assuming the commitment changed. A list can hold the assignment’s tasks, with headings separating stages and subtasks breaking down the next action.

This example explains Memorigi’s documented Do Date/Deadline distinction; it was not entered in the app. Use a clear acceptance condition, such as a reviewed submission, rather than treating a completed checkbox as proof of quality. Tags and views can organize attention, but they do not establish a team approval, dependency or capacity-planning system.
sections.zh:
假设课程作业周五到期，可以把周二设为打算写作的日子，保留周五截止承诺。执行移到周三时，应分别检查两个字段，不能假设承诺也改变。列表可容纳作业任务，标题分区划分阶段，子任务拆分下一动作。

此样例解释文档中的 Do Date／Deadline 区别，没有在应用输入。应定义清楚的验收条件，例如已复核提交，而不是把勾选完成当作品质证明。标签和视图可组织注意力，但不能据此确立团队审批、依赖或产能规划系统。

sections.title_en: Choose a fixed schedule or a completion-based repeat
sections.title_zh: 选择固定日程或完成后重复
sections.en:
The feature page distinguishes repetition on a fixed period from repetition after completing a task. Those represent different commitments: a weekly check should not silently become a delay that starts only after late completion, while a recovery interval may intentionally depend on completion.

In a pilot, inspect the next occurrence after completing one item on time and one late; also check its Do Date, deadline and reminder separately. The exact regeneration, missed-occurrence, timezone and undo rules were not established in the public material read. Android’s listing includes recurring reminder patterns among subscription-marked capabilities. Do not turn a generic reminder label into a promise that every background alert will arrive.
sections.zh:
功能页区分固定周期重复与任务完成后重复。两者表达不同承诺：每周检查不应静默变为延迟完成后才开始计算的间隔，而休整间隔也可能有意依赖完成时点。

试点应分别在按时及延迟完成后检查下一实例，并单独核对 Do Date、截止日和提醒。所读公开资料未确立具体再生成、遗漏实例、时区及撤销规则。Android 介绍把重复提醒模式列入带订阅标记能力。不能把通用提醒标签变为每次后台提醒必达承诺。

sections.title_en: Calendar viewing is not proof of two-way synchronization
sections.title_zh: 查看日历不证明双向同步
sections.en:
The website says Upcoming can display Google Calendar events, and the privacy policy says calendar data is copied into the Memorigi account during integration. Neither statement establishes full bidirectional event/task creation, deletion propagation or conflict resolution. The account sign-in page is separate from the marketing homepage.

Before connecting a real calendar, inspect the requested account and permissions, then compare one known event and task on the intended devices. The homepage says one Premium membership works across devices, but feature parity, offline edits and simultaneous-change handling still require checks. No Google access, sign-in link, mobile install or event operation was performed. An iOS reference in generic purchase terms is not proof of a currently available iOS client.
sections.zh:
官网称 Upcoming 可显示 Google Calendar 事件，隐私政策称集成时会把日历数据复制进 Memorigi 账户；两者均不能确立完整双向事件／任务创建、删除传播或冲突处理。账户登录页也独立于营销首页。

连接真实日历前，应检查请求的账户和权限，再在目标设备比较一个已知事件和任务。首页称单份 Premium 可跨设备使用，但功能一致、离线编辑及同时修改处理仍需核查。本次未授予 Google 访问、发送登录链接、安装手机端或操作事件。通用付款条款提及 iOS，也不证明当前存在可用 iOS 客户端。

sections.title_en: Free organizing and Premium extras need separate checks
sections.title_zh: 分别检查免费组织与 Premium 进阶功能
sections.en:
The homepage says the base app is free and displays Premium at $49.99/year, with $4.17/month as an equivalent rather than a separate monthly checkout quote. It places Cloud, Google Calendar, attachments, recurring tasks, subtasks, tags, deadlines and reminders among Premium benefits. The store description also uses broad free language but marks detailed advanced features with a subscription asterisk. Confirm the needed entitlement in the actual account.

Enterprise pricing is a quote; it does not by itself establish administrator controls or a team collaboration contract. Currency code, regional store rates, taxes, current quotas and any other billing cycles were not verified. No purchase or normalized universal rate is asserted.
sections.zh:
首页称基础应用免费，展示 Premium 每年 $49.99，$4.17／月是折合值，不是独立月付结账报价。它把 Cloud、Google Calendar、附件、重复任务、子任务、标签、截止日及提醒列为 Premium 权益。商店介绍也有宽泛免费文字，但具体进阶功能用订阅星号标记，所需权益应在实际账户确认。

Enterprise 需要询价，其名称本身不确立管理控制或团队协作合同。币种代码、地区商店价、税费、当前额度及其他周期未核实。本档案不声称已购买或统一归一化费率。

sections.title_en: Check cancellation timing before removing access
sections.title_zh: 取消前先核对权益结束时间
sections.en:
The public terms say subscriptions renew and that cancellation immediately removes subscription privileges. They separately allow a full annual Premium refund within thirty days of purchase or renewal, while monthly/bi-yearly cancellation is non-refundable. The homepage’s annual money-back statement is less detailed. Confirm purchase-channel rules and the exact access-end date before canceling.

The same terms schedule inactive accounts for deletion after a year and say deleted data cannot be recovered. The privacy page describes account deletion including uploaded files and provider processing in the United States. It reserves application rights to Memorigi while users retain their data; no source or self-hosting grant was established. Request export and restore details before relying on Cloud sync as a recoverable backup. No cancellation, erasure or restore was tested.
sections.zh:
公开条款称订阅续期，并称取消会立即失去订阅权益；另规定年付 Premium 在购买或续期后三十天内可全额退款，月付／bi-yearly 取消不退款。首页年付退款承诺较简略，取消前应确认购买渠道规则及确切权益结束日期。

同一条款安排一年不活跃账户删除，并称删除后无法恢复。隐私页说明删除账户包括上传文件，服务提供方在美国处理数据；它将应用权利保留给 Memorigi，用户保留数据权利，未确立源码或自托管授权。把 Cloud 同步当可恢复备份前，应索取导出和恢复细节。本次未测试取消、删除或恢复。

sections.title_en: Evaluate one real planning need at a time
sections.title_zh: 每次评估一个真实规划需求
sections.en:
Memorigi is a plausible shortlist for a person who wants a structured personal organizer with separate planned-work dates, deadlines and reminders. A team that needs permissioned assignments, audited approvals or authoritative invoicing should establish those capabilities separately; the existence of an Enterprise inquiry is not enough.

A compact evaluation is one task with both date types, a repeated item, an attachment and a calendar event. Inspect a delayed completion, a missed reminder and an unavailable-device case, then check which data can leave the service in a usable format. These are proposed tests only. Testimonials, app-store ratings, award labels and claims about procrastination or attention were not treated as independent outcomes.
sections.zh:
如果个人需要结构化组织，并区分计划执行日期、截止日和提醒，Memorigi 可以列入候选。团队需要带权限分派、可审计审批或权威开票时，应另行确立这些能力，不能只凭 Enterprise 询价入口。

精简评估可包含一项同时设置两种日期的任务、一项重复工作、一个附件及一个日历事件，检查延迟完成、漏提醒和设备不可用情形，再确认数据能否以可用格式离开服务。这些只是建议测试。评价、商店评分、奖项及拖延／注意力主张未当作独立结果。
